fix.ambiguous-corridor: adjust route/via or channel coordinates so unrelated relationships do not visually merge
fix.container-border-run: route across the frame perpendicularly through a clear opening
fix.desktop-readability: reduce the viewBox width, shorten node copy, widen affected nodes, or split the diagram so node context remains at least 6px at a 1440px desktop viewport
fix.finite-svg: replace non-finite coordinates before rendering again
fix.label-route-clearance: adjust labelAt, labelDx, labelDy, labelSegment, message y, or the other relationship route
fix.legend-clearance: move the route or enlarge the viewBox so relationships do not enter the legend
fix.micro-segment: move the route/channel/via point so every visible segment is at least 8px
fix.proper-crossing: adjust route/via or channel coordinates so unrelated relationships use separate corridors
fix.short-interior-segment: move the route/channel/via point so every interior turn has at least 16px
fix.single-svg: remove additional SVG roots so the artifact contains exactly one diagram SVG
